name: Heavy Metal Tested & Certified — standards open data
description: Machine-readable HMTc certification standards: the published limit per product subcategory, variant, and analyte, with basis, control, controlling jurisdiction and instrument. Set by Method v2.0. The literature evidence is reported independently at heavymetalindex.com.
methodology_version: HMTc-10 / Method v2.0 — government-limit default, selective occurrence for Tier-1 toxics and unregulated cells (CLAUDE.md Part 19)

datasets.name: Heavy Metal Tested & Certified — published standards
datasets.description: The HMTc certification limits per product subcategory, variant, and analyte: the published limit in ppb on the row's native basis, the control basis (government-limit default, government read-across, or controlled screen), the controlling jurisdiction and instrument, and — for government-limit cells — the per-country table of sovereign limits the value was selected from. Values are set by Method v2.0 (strictest applicable government maximum level, selective occurrence for Tier-1 toxics and unregulated cells).
